name: Tormus Deepforge
summary: At Ironforge’s Great Forge, Tormus Deepforge keeps weapons flowing to the Alliance. He coordinates iron deliveries and arms defenses across Khaz Modan and beyond.

sections.title: Master of the Great Forge
sections.body: Beside the Great Forge fires, Tormus Deepforge oversees the Bronzebeard clan’s metalwork. He still hammers steel himself, though he mourns Sturgy Ironband, his mentor. Dark Iron dwarves overran Sturgy’s smithing compound south of Helm’s Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh. A load of strange umbral ore had arrived there.

faq.q: Where can I find Tormus Deepforge?
faq.answer: Tormus stands on the circular walkway around the lava pool at the heart of Ironforge.

faq.q: What role does Tormus play in the Alliance war effort?
faq.answer: At the Great Forge, Tormus forges weapons for young warriors who come to him. He asks them to avenge his mentor, Sturgy Ironband, by entering Ironband’s Compound in Dun Morogh and recovering the umbral ore the Dark Iron dwarves killed for. Tormus works the ore into new grey iron weapons.
Several dwarves share the Deepforge name, including Bengus, Murgot, and Kaita Deepforge, as well as Tormus’s colleague Thorvald in Loch Modan. Their relationships have never been confirmed.

angles.text: At the Great Forge, Tormus links raw bar stock to weapons for the front lines.
As a dwarf, you see Tormus’s work reflect Ironforge’s readiness to smelt and deliver arms when allies in the Grand Alliance call for aid.
